lines.t: [Intimate, sparse acoustic guitar intro]
A bitter wind... it's sweeping through
The love we had, the things we knew
Every kindness... starts to break
Oh, look at the mess they make
They're running fast, they scheme at night
Hiding away from the light
But You see it all...
The love of man has lost its heat
It's freezing cold on every street
We're just captives... captives to the dark
Running on empty... without a spark
The heart of man has turned to stone
And we are so alone...
They rob the poor, they lock the door
Always wanting more and more
They applaud the pain, they love the night
Walking away from what is right
And every evening, when they lie down
A shadow falls across this town
But judgment is near...
The love of man has lost its heat
It's freezing cold on every street
We're just captives... captives to the dark
Running on empty... without a spark
The heart of man has turned to stone
And we are so alone...
The King is coming... look at the sky
Lift your eyes... don't just pass by
Captives... captives...
Before the dawn.
